desc: Parse N, M and precolored cells.
Track per-row max black column and min white column with sentinels.
Track per-column max black row and min white row with sentinels.
Update row/col stats from each precolored cell based on B/W.
Verify rows with both colors satisfy max_black < min_white.
Verify columns with both colors satisfy max_black_row < min_white_row.
Output "Yes" if all checks pass, otherwise "No".
